long_biography.plain_text:
Patrick Joseph Dovigi began as an ice-hockey goaltender and was drafted by the Edmonton Oilers before moving into business. In finance, he was assigned to repair a troubled waste investment, a prolonged clean-up that showed him both the industry's operational demands and its fragmentation. He founded GFL Environmental in 2007, acquired regional operators and joined solid and liquid waste services in a one-stop model.

Dovigi turned that initial platform into a broader network through disciplined acquisitions, using regional businesses as bases for further consolidation while retaining local operating responsibility. He continues to lead GFL as founder, chairman, president and chief executive. A later philanthropic strand returned to his sporting formation: he helped establish the Dovigi Family Sports Medicine Clinic to combine medical, rehabilitation, imaging and surgical care for sports injuries.
